guide.sign-in.title: First sign-in
guide.sign-in.why: So you can open the program with your account.
guide.first-setup.title: Shop setup
guide.first-setup.why: So the program keeps the shop name and the owner account.
guide.shop-settings.title: Shop details
guide.shop-settings.why: So the receipt shows the shop details.
guide.add-user.title: Add a person
guide.add-user.why: So each person works with their own account and permissions.
guide.backup.title: Backup
guide.backup.why: So the shop data stays safe.
guide.backup.ok: The copy is saved on this PC.
guide.home-today.title: Today
guide.home-today.why: So you can see today's sales quickly.
guide.open-shift.title: Open the shift
guide.open-shift.why: So you record the cash you start with.
guide.make-sale.title: Make a sale
guide.make-sale.why: So you record the sale, the payment and the change.
guide.make-sale.3: Pick the product from the list.
guide.collect-instalment.title: Collect an instalment
guide.collect-instalment.why: So the customer payment is recorded.
guide.collect-instalment.2: Open the customer or the due list.
guide.record-expense.title: Record an expense
guide.record-expense.why: So the amount leaves the drawer with a clear reason.
guide.read-shift.title: Read the shift
guide.read-shift.why: So you know the expected cash before closing.
guide.read-shift.3: Compare it with what you expect.
guide.safe-move.title: Move safe cash
guide.safe-move.why: So you move cash between the drawer and the safe.
guide.close-shift.title: Close the shift
guide.close-shift.why: So you match the cash and close the shift.
guide.close-shift.4: Check the difference before you save.
guide.take-return.title: Record a return
guide.take-return.why: So the item comes back and the money is refunded.
guide.take-return.2: Open a sale from the list.
guide.read-reports.title: Read the reports
guide.read-reports.why: So you see the period sales.
guide.read-reports.2: Choose a period from the buttons.
guide.read-reports.3: Read the numbers at the top.
guide.read-stock.title: Search stock
guide.read-stock.why: So you find how many of an item you have.
guide.receive-goods.title: Receive goods
guide.receive-goods.why: So the quantity in the store goes up.
guide.receive-goods.2: Choose the supplier from the list.
problem.sign-in-wrong.why: The name or password is wrong, or the account is off.
problem.sign-in-wrong.do.1: Type the name and password again.
problem.password-weak.why: The password is short, easy, or the same as the name.
problem.password-weak.do.1: Type a password longer than 8 characters.
problem.people-guard.why: The name is already used, or that permission is not allowed.
problem.people-guard.do.1: Change the name or choose another profile.
problem.no-permission.why: Your account does not have this permission.
problem.no-permission.do.1: Ask the owner to grant it.
problem.licence-locked.see: The licence does not allow changes.
problem.licence-locked.why: The code is missing, expired, or for another PC.
problem.licence-locked.do.1: Open Settings and paste a valid code.
problem.bad-request.why: A number, a date or a field is not valid.
problem.bad-request.do.1: Correct the field and try again.
problem.setup-done.why: The shop is already set up.
problem.setup-done.do.1: Sign in with the owner account.
problem.backup-bad.why: The file is damaged or belongs to another shop.
problem.backup-bad.do.1: Choose another copy from the list.
problem.no-shift.why: A sale and an expense need an open shift.
problem.no-shift.do.1: Open a shift from the Cash page.
problem.drawer-diff.why: The counted amount differs from the expected amount.
problem.drawer-diff.do.1: Write the reason in the note.
problem.cash-form.why: The amount, the reason or the source is missing.
problem.cash-form.do.1: Fill in the amount and the reason.
problem.sale-lines.why: There is no product, or the payment does not match the total.
problem.sale-lines.do.1: Add a product and check the payment.
problem.sale-serial.why: The number is missing, repeated, or in another place.
problem.sale-serial.do.1: Choose the number that is in the shop.
problem.sale-approval.why: The discount or the return is above your limit.
problem.sale-approval.do.1: Ask a manager to approve it.
problem.sale-customer.why: A credit sale needs a customer and a down payment.
problem.sale-customer.do.1: Choose the customer and check the down payment.
problem.return-problem.why: The quantity is more than was sold, or the condition is missing.
problem.return-problem.do.1: Lower the quantity and choose the condition.
problem.stock-short.why: The quantity is not enough, or the place is not valid.
problem.stock-short.do.1: Check the quantity and the place.
problem.receive-problem.why: The amount paid is more than the invoice, or the supplier is missing.
problem.receive-problem.do.1: Lower the paid amount or choose the supplier.
problem.customer-problem.why: The phone is already used, or the national ID is incomplete.
problem.customer-problem.do.1: Correct the phone or the ID number.
problem.product-problem.why: The code, the price or the unit is not valid.
problem.product-problem.do.1: Correct the field that is marked.
problem.support-problem.why: The address or the code is missing.
problem.support-problem.do.1: Type an address that starts with https.
problem.reason-needed.why: A reversal or a stock count needs a clear reason.
problem.reason-needed.do.1: Type a reason of 3 characters or more.
problem.watch-page.why: This page is for the owner and anyone with its permission.
problem.watch-page.do.1: Open an alert and read why it appeared.
